docValue: white disc r 32, Gaussian σ 16, so α = .5 at r 32 and → 0 at r 64. Same profile as a CSS box-shadow blur
boardEvidence: L47 `0 0 18px rgba(244,107,196,.35)`, L55 `0 0 20px rgba(244,107,196,.8)`: CSS blur B = Gaussian σ B/2 across a straight edge, so α is .5 at the edge and ≈.98 at edge−B. A blurred r32 disc with σ16 is a different profile: centre α = 1−e^−2 ≈ .865, and at r 32 α = 1−Q1(2,2) ≈ .40 (not .5). The stretched 9-slice centre (Rect 63–65) and the edge pieces carry this disc profile, so every glow edge is about 20 % too faint and the core is never opaque.
fix: Bake the profile directly instead of blurring a disc: α(r) = .5·erfc((r−32)/(16·√2)), which gives .5 at r 32, ≈.98 at r 0 and ≈.02 at r 64. Drop the claim that the blurred r32 disc equals the CSS profile.

docValue: all glows (glass, pass, boost, skin…) = U1 behind the element
boardEvidence: CSS outer box-shadow is never painted under the element's border box. The glowing fills here are translucent: L47 `.gl` rgba(130,70,220,.55)→rgba(50,20,110,.62) with `0 0 18px rgba(244,107,196,.35)`, L273 `.pass` rgba(255,255,255,.14)→rgba(20,6,60,.88) with `0 0 14px var(--rc)`, L281–282 `.bst` rgba(10,2,40,.55) with `.on` `0 0 14px rgba(93,255,192,.45)`, L297 `.skin` rgba(255,255,255,.1)→… with `0 0 12px var(--rc)`. A full U1 disc behind them shows the glow colour through the fill. The doc's own L410 rejects tinted copies behind translucent fills for exactly this reason ("would bleed the border colour through").
fix: Make U1 an outer-only glow: α = 0 for r < 32, then the erfc tail from .5 at r 32 to 0 at r 64. The 9-slice centre is then transparent, which matches CSS clipping. Alternatively, state that the bleed is accepted on glass, pass, boost and skin, and list it as a deviation for owner sign-off.

docValue: L55 radial (white α .6 at 50%/28%, 52%) baked; used for orb, porb, cpic, bring; only cost = cpic/porb sit slightly higher
boardEvidence: L283–284 `.bring` has no radial highlight (`conic-gradient(var(--go) 0 var(--p),rgba(255,255,255,.18) 0)` and an inner `#2b1457`), so "bring highlights" do not exist.
